'''Rokarian dirt-fish fillet''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] made from the meat of [[Rokarian dirt-fish/Legends|Rokarian dirt-fish]].<ref name="Menu" /> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], sold a fried [[Rokarian dirt-fish fillet sandwich]]es with a cup of [[Soup/Legends|soup]] for 6.1 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as part of its lunch and dinner [[Pantoran Plate Specials]] on [[Benduday/Legends|Bendudays]].<ref name="Menu" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Rokarian dirt-fish fillets were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
